title: Check: Volume of Pyramids and Cones

questions.stem: What is the volume of a cone with radius $3\text{ cm}$ and height $7\text{ cm}$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cone $= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3} \times \pi \times 9 \times 7 = 21\pi\text{ cm}^3$.
